full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white photograph in which the visible scene appears only inside a small circular window. Most of the frame is deep black. The circle lies near the center and contains a distorted view of an interior with a person holding a camera up to the face. Pale sleeves and hands are visible around the dark lens, which points directly toward the viewer. The photographer's eyes and upper head appear behind it. A dark paneled wall with framed pictures occupies the left side of the circular image. On the right, a bright window and layered curtains reveal a pale street or buildings outside. The extreme wide-angle or pinhole-like view bends vertical lines near the circle's perimeter. The wall and window curve inward, and clarity falls off quickly toward the dark edge. The round vignette itself has a blurred uneven rim rather than a hard graphic border. Within the circle, bright window light contrasts with the dark wall and black camera. Fine grain, soft focus, and a little tonal unevenness give the image an analog character. There is no information in the black surrounding field; its large area makes the small captured world feel isolated and discovered through a narrow aperture. The photographer is centrally placed, but the window on one side and shadowed interior on the other create asymmetric light. The image is simple in subject yet unusual in framing. It emphasizes the act of looking through a hole, the optical bend of a wide circular view, and the distance between an enclosed observed scene and the black outside it. The overall mood is curious and intimate, with a playful self-reflective quality grounded in physical lens distortion.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白照片，可见场景只出现在一只小圆窗口里。画面大部分深黑。圆在中央附近，里面是扭曲的室内景，一人把相机举到脸前。浅色袖和手围住朝向观者的深镜头。摄影者的眼和头上部在其后方。圆内左侧是一面深护板墙，上面挂着框画。右侧明亮窗与层层窗帘露出外面的浅色街道或建筑。极广角或针孔般的视野使圆周附近竖线弯曲。墙与窗向内卷，清晰度迅速向深边缘衰减。圆形暗角自身有模糊不均匀边，而非硬图形框。圆内，亮窗光对照深墙与黑相机。细颗粒、柔焦和少许调子不均让图像有模拟摄影性格。黑色外域没有信息；其大面积让小小被摄世界像通过狭窄孔径发现。摄影者居中，但一侧窗与另一侧阴暗室内形成不对称光。题材简单，框取却不寻常。它强调透孔观看的动作、圆形广视野的光学弯曲，以及被包住的可见场景与外部黑暗之间的距离。整体好奇而亲密，带嬉戏般自我反观的性质，并立足于真实镜头畸变。
style_prompt_en: Analog-looking photographic treatment encloses a distorted scene inside a small circular opening surrounded by expansive black. The aperture edge is soft and uneven, with focus and brightness falling toward its perimeter. Extreme wide-angle curvature bends nearby straight lines and makes the interior feel compact. Bright windows or highlights oppose deep shadow within the circle, while grain and tonal variation keep the optical effect physical. The empty black outer field becomes a major compositional mass. A central focal point can remain recognizable despite the surrounding blur. The result is curious, intimate, and self-conscious about the act of seeing through a limited lens.
style_prompt_zh: 模拟摄影感处理把弯曲场景收在小圆开口里，周围是宽阔黑域。孔径边缘柔和且不均匀，对焦和亮度向周边衰减。极广角曲率弯折附近直线，使内部显得紧凑。圆内亮窗或高光对照深影，颗粒与调子变化使光学效果有物理感。空黑外域成为主要构图体块。中央焦点即使被周围模糊包围仍可辨。结果好奇、亲密，且让人意识到通过有限镜头观看这一行为。
theme_en: A photographer reflected within a small circular pinhole view
theme_zh: 一名摄影者映在圆形针孔视域内
name: Pinhole lens
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
